name: Tokamak
desc: The poloidal cross-section of a fusion machine, where nothing is drawn and everything falls out of the flux the coils make — a distributed plasma current nested in closed surfaces, a coil beneath it pulling the field to a null so the separatrix breaks open into an X-point and sends its legs down to the divertor plates, the resonant surfaces torn into slowly rotating chains of magnetic islands, and the core running its sawtooth forever: peak, reconnect, dump its heat outward as a ring, and peak again.

energy.doc: stored energy — plasma temperature and profile fullness, the Shafranov shift that pushes the magnetic axis outward, sawtooth rate, island width and how far the scrape-off layer glows (the master knob)

scale.doc: machine size — a small tight bore in a big vessel, or a plasma that fills the frame and pushes the blanket off the edges

speed.doc: time rate (0.15 still rotates its islands and still sawteeth)

density.doc: how many flux surfaces are drawn, and how many rational surfaces have torn into island chains — from one clean 2/1 chain to a core crowded with 3/2 and 5/n islands too

tri.doc: triangularity — pulls the shaping coils inboard and squashes the round plasma into the D-section every real machine runs

hue.doc: false-colour temperature scale hue; photograph, contour_map, ironbow and bolometer set their own on purpose

style.doc: aesthetic: clinical false-colour temperature reconstruction with the flux surfaces contoured over it / a visible-light shot down a viewport, the plasma a violet glow off polished metal / abstracted cyan drafting blueprint — no fill at all, pure flux topology as contour line with the SOL picked out in amber / ironbow thermal / austere greyscale bolometer plate of radiated power

seed.doc: deterministic seed for plate grain and the island phases
